//: An example brand. Copy the folder example/ to profile/ in the repo's root (ignored by git), fill it in, try it with npm run preview and assemble the publish folder with npm run deploy (both use profile/ automatically). Fields that start with // are comments and are ignored.
// company: name: the company's name (shown in the header and the tab). short: an optional short form.
// language: Optional: the app's language as a two-letter language code, "en" (English) or "sv" (Swedish). Swedish is used if the field is missing or the language is not in the app.
// logo: File name of an image in the same folder (png, svg, jpg or webp, at most 1 MB) or an https address. Shown at 44×44 px.
// colors: accent: buttons and labels. ink: main text. bg: background. accentHover (optional): a button under the mouse pointer. Everything else, dark mode too, is worked out and contrast-checked (WCAG AA 4.5:1). overrides.light / overrides.dark can override single variables: bg, surface, sunk, ink, text, muted, line, accent, accent-hover, accent-ink, brand-soft, focus, info, shadow.
// fonts: display: headings, body: body text. system-ui = the computer's own font. With googleFonts: true the names are loaded from Google Fonts.
// senders: Senders for mail signatures. signature is the signature's lines in order. A company usually has one; more are only needed if some customer types should get another sender (see customerTypes[].sender).
// customerTypes: Customer types (a customer can have several). id: a–z, 0–9, - and _; never change it once customers have the type. label: the name that is shown. color: #rrggbb (colorDark optional for dark mode). icon: person, kamera, film, sandning, pokal, stjarna, portfolj, kalender, pratbubbla or prick (the app's own icons), or a lucide name like calendar-days (lucide.dev/icons; an unknown name gives a dot) – or svg: an icon of your own (SVG content for viewBox 0 0 16 16; only the elements path, circle, rect, line, polyline, polygon, ellipse and g, with drawing attributes such as d, fill and stroke). sender: an optional sender for customers with the type.
